text: Ethics in AI is becoming a serious topic as artificial intelligence spreads into daily life. One major concern is bias: if AI learns from unfair data, it can make unfair decisions about jobs, loans, or healthcare. Fairness means treating all people equally, no matter who they are. Privacy is also important, because AI systems often collect and use personal information. People should know how their data is used. Transparency helps here: companies should explain how their AI makes decisions. Finally, responsible AI development means building systems that are safe, honest, and good for society. Governments, engineers, and users must all work together to make sure AI helps everyone fairly.
